formalizationGap.title: TRIGGER / SETUP / PASS / FAIL AUTHORITY GAP
formalizationGap.description: Setup and Trigger are free text in every row, and PASS/FAIL carry free-text qualifiers beyond their result ContractId. NPM-V34 defines ContractIds for states, verifiers, context, schedule/execution points and cleanup, but not for setup actions, trigger actions or the qualifier predicates. Mutation, PrimaryTransactionId, TopTransactionId, DocumentLock and UNKNOWN cells also carry natural-language qualifiers (e.g. 'MUT-ALL after legal delivery lock/T acquisition', 'origin T or NONE', 'observed top T'); each row's formalizationGaps lists the affected columns. Named formal entries the verification identified as needed include a SEND delivery execution contract (counterpart of CMDCTX-EXEC-01), the fixture command identity, the NX-APPCTX-SYNC driver context and the host operation behind each trigger verb.
formalizationGap.scope: All 100 rows, including the 32 hard-blocked rows.
